children: On October 23, 2026, Charlton Aria Acquisition notified Nasdaq that it had failed to comply with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5605(c)(2)(A) because an audit committee member did not meet Exchange Act Rule 10A-3 independence criteria. The company says it restored compliance on October 22, 2026, after removing the member from the audit committee and appointing a replacement; its securities continue to trade on Nasdaq.
